newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: RABO SECURITIES ACQUIRES ROBECO BROKERAGE.
newsitem.headline: RABO SECURITIES ACQUIRES ROBECO BROKERAGE.

text.p: Cooperative bank Rabobank Nederland said on Friday its unit Rabo Securities NV would take over all activities of Robeco Effectenbank NV on November 15.
All activities of Robeco's brokerage unit will be integrated into the Rabo organisation as soon as possible, Rabo said in a statement.
Robeco Effectenbank's fixed income activities will be taken over by the fixed income department of Rabobank International in the central Dutch city of Utrecht.
All other activities will be integrated into Rabo Securities, Rabo's Amsterdam based unit.
Rabo added the integration will not cause any forced redundancies.
No financial details of the transaction were disclosed.
